name: Iron Maiden

whyMatters.en: NWOBHM band formed in London in 1975. The Dickinson–Murray–Smith twin-guitar years and The Number of the Beast (1982) fixed Harris gallop rhythm and concept lyrics as a global touring metal sound.
whyMatters.zh: NWOBHM 乐队，1975 年于伦敦成立。Dickinson–Murray–Smith 双吉他时期与 The Number of the Beast（1982）把 Harris 疾驰节奏与概念歌词定成全球巡演金属声音。

note.en: Dickinson debut album peak; Harris gallop, twin leads, concept lyric.
note.zh: Dickinson 首张峰值专辑；Harris 疾驰、双主音、概念歌词。

note.en: Clear gallop riff example; Crimean War lyric over dual-lead harmony.
note.zh: 清晰的疾驰 riff 范例；克里米亚战争歌词压在双主音和声上。

note.en: Di'Anno era: street-metal bark before Dickinson’s wider mid-high range.
note.zh: Di'Anno 时期：街头金属吠叫，Dickinson 更宽中高音区之前。

interviewQuotes.text: We do not play soft rock.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Steve Harris

interviewQuotes.text: I joined a band that already had an identity.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Bruce Dickinson

interviewQuotes.text: My heart and soul went to Britain, to Iron Maiden. (Chinese-edition wording; not a verified English original.)
interviewQuotes.speaker: Lars Ulrich

lyricQuotes: You'll take my life but I'll take yours too
Run to the hills, run for your lives

shortBio.en: Harris gallop metal; Di'Anno then Dickinson; The Trooper is the twin-lead reference track.
shortBio.zh: Harris 疾驰金属；Di'Anno 后换 Dickinson；The Trooper 是双主音参照曲。

body.en:
Formed in London in 1975 by Steve Harris. The early-1980s breakthrough is Killers, The Number of the Beast, and Piece of Mind—Harris’s eighth-note bass gallop, twin leads, and Bruce Dickinson’s operatic mid-high range.

The Trooper (1983) is the clearest single-track example of that method. The Eddie mascot and long tours support the live brand; musically the band scales New Wave of British Heavy Metal to arenas without thrash BPM.

Harris formed the band in 1975. The first stable record lineup was Di’Anno, Murray, Dennis Stratton, and Clive Burr. Self-released Soundhouse Tapes (1979) sold out to the fan club. Iron Maiden (1980) hit UK #4 and led the NWOBHM shelf with Def Leppard, Saxon, and Diamond Head. Stratton was out before Killers (1981); Adrian Smith came in. Di’Anno was fired and Bruce Dickinson arrived from Samson for The Number of the Beast (1982), UK #1; Run to the Hills made the UK top 10. Nicko McBrain replaced Burr in 1982. The World Slavery Tour (1984–85) was issued as Live After Death. Donington Monsters of Rock 1988 and Seventh Son of a Seventh Son (UK #1 the same year) sit in the book as the live and studio peaks. Dickinson left in 1993; Smith left; Janick Gers (ex-Gillan) and Blaze Bayley (Wolfsbane) came in for The X Factor (1995) and Virtual XI (1998). Dickinson and Smith returned in 1999; Gers stayed, so the band ran three guitars. Brave New World (2000), Dance of Death (2003), and A Matter of Life and Death (2006) followed. From 2008 to 2011 Dickinson flew the band and about 12 tons of gear on a Boeing 757, Ed Force One, filmed as Flight 666.
body.zh:
1975 年由 Steve Harris 于伦敦组建。1980 年代初的突破是 Killers、The Number of the Beast 与 Piece of Mind——Harris 的八分音符贝斯疾驰、双主音、Bruce Dickinson 的歌剧式中高音区。

The Trooper（1983）是这套方法最清晰的单曲范例。Eddie 吉祥物与长巡演支撑现场品牌；音乐上乐队把 NWOBHM 扩到体育场，却不走 thrash BPM。

Harris 1975 年建队。第一套稳定录音阵容是 Di’Anno、Murray、Dennis Stratton、Clive Burr。1980 年同名专辑英国榜第 4，与 Def Leppard、Saxon、Diamond Head 同列 NWOBHM。Killers（1981）前 Stratton 离队，Adrian Smith 进入。Di’Anno 被换下，来自 Samson 的 Bruce Dickinson 唱 The Number of the Beast（1982，英国榜首）；Run to the Hills 进英国前十。1982 年 Nicko McBrain 接替 Burr。World Slavery Tour（1984–85）收成 Live After Death。书中把 1988 年 Donington Monsters of Rock 与同年英国榜首的 Seventh Son of a Seventh Son 当作现场与录音峰值。1993 年 Dickinson 离队，Smith 也离开；Janick Gers（前 Gillan）与 Blaze Bayley（Wolfsbane）录 The X Factor（1995）和 Virtual XI（1998）。1999 年 Dickinson 与 Smith 回归，Gers 留下，于是三把吉他。随后是 Brave New World（2000）、Dance of Death（2003）、A Matter of Life and Death（2006）。2008–2011 年 Dickinson 驾驶波音 757“Ed Force One”，载乐队与约 12 吨设备巡演，纪录片《Flight 666》记录此事。

title.en: Gallop and twin lead in NWOBHM
title.zh: NWOBHM 中的疾驰与双主音

body.en:
Harris’s eighth-note bass gallop, Murray/Smith dual leads, and concept lyrics define Iron Maiden’s sound. The Number of the Beast (1982) takes NWOBHM from clubs to global touring without thrash BPM.

Eddie the mascot sits beside the riffs as visual branding.
body.zh:
Harris 八分贝斯疾驰、Murray/Smith 双主音与概念歌词定义 Iron Maiden 的声音。The Number of the Beast（1982）把 NWOBHM 从俱乐部带到全球巡演，却不走 thrash BPM。

Eddie 吉祥物作为视觉品牌，与 riff 并列。

title.zh: Di'Anno 吠叫到 Dickinson 音域

body.en:
Paul Di'Anno fronts Iron Maiden and Killers with a street bark. Bruce Dickinson joins in 1981; The Number of the Beast brings a wider mid-high range and longer forms.

The singer swap keeps Harris’s gallop writing in place.
body.zh:
Paul Di'Anno 以街头吠叫主唱 Iron Maiden 与 Killers。Bruce Dickinson 于 1981 加入；The Number of the Beast 带来更宽的中高音区与更长曲式。

换主唱后，Harris 的疾驰写法仍在。

body.en:
Open gallop riff, twin-lead harmony, Crimean War lyric. McBrain-era drums. One cut that shows Maiden’s rhythm and dual-guitar method clearly.

Run to the Hills and Hallowed Be Thy Name sit as Beast-era companions.
body.zh:
开放疾驰 riff、双主音和声、克里米亚战争歌词。McBrain 时期鼓。一首就能清楚看见 Maiden 的节奏与双吉他方法。

Run to the Hills 与 Hallowed Be Thy Name 是 Beast 时期同伴。

alt.en: Iron Maiden at Bercy, Paris, 1 July 2008
alt.zh: Iron Maiden，巴黎贝尔西体育馆，2008 年 7 月 1 日

title.zh: Harris 律动，双吉他和声主音

body.en:
Harris writes and drives from bass. Murray and Smith trade harmony leads more than shred contests. Dickinson’s mid-high range carries narrative lyrics over the gallop.

The Di'Anno chapter remains the street-metal citation.
body.zh:
Harris 从贝斯写作并驱动。Murray 与 Smith 交换和声主音多于炫技对决。Dickinson 中高音区承载叙事歌词压在疾驰上。

Di'Anno 章节仍是街头金属引用。

alt.en: Steve Harris, Adrian Smith, and Bruce Dickinson at Sonisphere, Madrid, 2013
alt.zh: Steve Harris、Adrian Smith 与 Bruce Dickinson，马德里 Sonisphere，2013

body.en:
Harris’s hard-line metal claim and Dickinson’s “already had identity” line mark continuity through the vocal swap.

Quotes document method, not mystique.
body.zh:
Harris 的硬线金属主张与 Dickinson「乐队已有身份」句，标记换主唱下的连续性。

引语记录方法，不造神秘。

title.zh: Thrash 峰值前的体育场金属

body.en:
Metallica and other 80s metal acts cite gallop rhythm and twin-lead writing. Maiden keep concept albums and long tours as a stable live practice.

NWOBHM scaled without losing the Harris pocket.

Lars Ulrich, quoted in the Chinese edition: his heart and soul had gone to Britain, to Iron Maiden. The book later pairs Maiden with Metallica as the arena-metal acts still touring at that scale after the 1990s.
body.zh:
Metallica 与其他 80 年代金属引用疾驰节奏与双主音写作。Maiden 把概念专集与长巡演当作稳定的现场做法。

NWOBHM 放大而不丢 Harris 律动。

中文版所引 Lars Ulrich：他的心与魂去了英国，在 Iron Maiden 那里。后文把 Maiden 与 Metallica 并列，视为 90 年代之后仍维持这一巡演规模的金属乐队。

note.en: Di’Anno, Murray, Stratton, Burr, Harris. Smith replaced Stratton for Killers (1981).
Dickinson from Samson; McBrain replaced Burr in 1982. Gers joined around 1990 and stayed when Smith returned in 1999. Bayley sang 1994–1999.
note.zh: Dickinson 来自 Samson；1982 年 McBrain 接替 Burr。Gers 约 1990 年加入，1999 年 Smith 回归后仍留下。Bayley 主唱 1994–1999。

note.en: Dickinson-era album single that carried NWOBHM to a global audience.
note.zh: Dickinson 时期专辑单曲，把 NWOBHM 带到全球听众。

note.en: Gallop bass, twin lead, and concept lyric as a touring metal sound.
note.zh: 疾驰贝斯、双主音与概念歌词，构成巡演金属声音。
